summary: Sporting News guide to the best NBA betting sites and apps for the 2023-24 season, profiling DraftKings, FanDuel, BetMGM and BetRivers and their welcome offers and features. It explains how to sign up, what to look for in a sportsbook, line shopping, live betting, bet types (spreads, moneylines, totals, props, futures), the season calendar, and the legal background of US sports betting since 2018.
one_line: A Sporting News guide comparing top NBA sportsbooks for 2023-24, explaining signup, bet types, line shopping, live betting, and US legality.
key_facts: Legal sports betting is available in over 30 states, following a 2018 US Supreme Court decision that overturned a longstanding federal law and let states set their own sports betting rules.
DraftKings Sportsbook needs no special code for a new-customer promo with total promotional value of up to $1,200; a past NBA offer gave $200 in bonus bets for a $5 bet on any NBA Finals game.
FanDuel Sportsbook typically gives newcomers $150 in bonus bets, may add three months of NBA League Pass, and requires signing up, depositing and placing a $5 bet; it also offers same-game parlays.
BetMGM's sports betting app is described as the only one that offers live streaming of NBA games.

BetMGM usually offers new accounts a bonus of up to $1,500, returning the value in bonus bets if the first bet loses; a past promo was 'bet $10, get $200' at 20-1 odds that won if a single three-point field goal was scored.
BetRivers has an integrated sportsbook and online casino app on one account, plus the iRush Rewards program in which points earned on sports bets can be used on its online casino.
BetRivers' past 'NBA Wednesdays' promotion allowed wagers up to $25 on any Wednesday NBA game with a 20% profit boost; new accounts typically get a second-chance bet up to $500, varying by state.

Signing up requires first and last name, date of birth, home address, phone number, email, username and password, and Social Security number; bettors must be within state lines where betting is legal to wager.
The article advises line shopping, for example using two books if one offers the Boston Celtics at +800 and another at +1500.
Key factors for choosing a site are deposits and payouts, NBA odds, user experience, and safety and security.

The 2023-24 NBA season begins October 24, with an in-season tournament November 3 - December 9, All-Star Weekend February 16-18, regular season ending April 14, play-in April 16-19, playoffs starting April 20, and NBA Finals Game 1 on June 6.
In the example, Knicks at -7.5 over the Heat must win by 8 points to cover, and with an over/under of 211.5 the over needs 212 or more combined points.
